write.title: Changing the band saw blade
write.html:
Changing the band saw blade

Before you start

Unplug the saw and wait for the wheels to stop.

Steps

  1. Release the blade tension with the top handwheel.
  2. Open both wheel covers.
  3. Lift the old blade off the wheels wearing gloves.
  • Fold the old blade into three loops before you carry it.
  • Never leave a blade loose on the floor.

Settings

BladeTeeth per inchUse
6 mm14thin steel
12 mm6wood

Re-tension until the gauge reads 15 000 psi.
